stem: Which statement best describes a complete cultivation biosecurity program?
choices: It is mainly a schedule for chemical disinfection
It combines clean starting material, quarantine, sanitation, controlled movement, waste handling and environmental prevention
It replaces the need for crop scouting
It applies only to propagation areas
rationale: Biosecurity is a system of preventive practices that includes material control, workflow, sanitation, movement, waste and environmental management rather than disinfection alone.
